affiliations.date_precision: The exact-private-identifier Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 105 on July 14, 1942; the code names no employer, office, industry, or exact duties.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms the Army-entry row. The later Staff Sergeant grade is compatible with advancement. No company, office, industry, duties, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.

affiliations.date_precision: The exact-private-identifier Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 068 on December 15, 1942; the residual code names no profession, employer, workplace, or duties.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms only the Master Sergeant index row. The broad residual code does not establish a profession or employer, and it is not assigned to the adjacent identifier-free John R. Bennet row.

claims.claim_text: The official Army-entry record is confirmed as the William A. Benner listed as a Staff Sergeant in the OSS personnel index.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official files share the exact full name and exact private identifier; the Army-entry private grade is compatible with the later Staff Sergeant index grade.
claims.identity_match_assessment: A unique private identifier is decisive, with exact name agreement and compatible enlisted grades providing corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to July 14, 1942; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS route or date.
claims.match_notes: The identifier is retained privately and masked publicly. Other official Army rows with the same name did not share the index identifier and were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on July 14, 1942, William A. Benner was classified as a general-office clerk.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-matched Army record carries code 105, which NARA's corrected list defines as clerks, general office.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms that the coded Army-entry record belongs to the indexed William A. Benner.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry, but not proven to identify a named employer or the immediate pre-OSS role.
claims.match_notes: No company, government office, industry, workplace, or self-employment status is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The official Army-entry record is confirmed as the John R. Bennet listed as a Master Sergeant on page 31 of the OSS personnel index.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The page-31 index row and Army-entry record share the exact private identifier and exact name; the Army private grade is compatible with the later Master Sergeant grade.
claims.identity_match_assessment: A unique private identifier is decisive for the page-31 Master Sergeant row. It does not by itself identify the adjacent identifier-free row on page 32.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to December 15, 1942; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS route or date.
claims.match_notes: The identifier is retained privately and masked publicly. Both index rows remain separate pending comparison of the physical files.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on December 15, 1942, the John R. Bennet represented by the page-31 Master Sergeant row was classified in a semiprofessional occupation not elsewhere classified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-matched Army record carries code 068; NARA's corrected list identifies a residual semiprofessional group but names no profession or employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms the code for the page-31 Master Sergeant row only; it is not assigned to the identifier-free page-32 row.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry, but not proven to identify a named employer, exact profession, or immediate pre-OSS role.
claims.match_notes: No profession, company, institution, job title, or intervening affiliation is inferred from the residual code.
